record.headline: Aircall cut its pay-as-you-go rate for extra AI Voice Agent minutes from $0.49 to $0.29 per minute and replaced the 500 and 2,500 minute bundles with 1,000, 3,500 and 10,000 minute bundles.
rows: Pay as you go, per minute
record.who: Aircall customers who buy AI Voice Agents minutes beyond the 50 included minutes on Essentials and Professional.
record.read: The pay-as-you-go rate now matches the old 2,500 minute bundle rate, so small users no longer need a commitment to get a low per-minute price. The bundle ladder is reset around a 1,000 minute entry point, which looks aimed at driving AI Voice Agents adoption.
record.caveat: The old and new bundles do not line up one for one, so the effective per-minute price at some volumes may go up (for example 500 minutes cost $175 before and the smallest bundle is now 1,000 minutes for $250).
